correctness.rationale: Parity-lift identity is exact for complete even-length cyclic substitution iterates. Absence of 11 and 0000 excludes all cyclic four-letter palindromes, hence even palindromes beyond 00. Every odd center is either a lifted lower-rank odd palindrome (two injective forms) or one of the two short exceptional center-even factors; maximality checked through absence of lower-rank four-letter palindromes. Disjointness and no-truncation boundary yield recursion and total. Complete factor-set enumeration through rank 9 corroborates.
